findings.title: Data race on shared `err` and `totalBatchesIndexed` variables in `searchSupport.init`
findings.body: Now that `bleveBackend.BuildIndex` no longer serializes the entire build under `b.cacheMu.Lock()`, the `group.Go` worker goroutines in `searchSupport.init` run `s.build` concurrently. Inside the closure, `totalBatchesIndexed++` (line 189) and `_, _, err = s.build(...)` (line 190) mutate variables declared in the outer `init` scope without synchronization, while the main goroutine also writes `err = group.Wait()` at line 195. In addition to triggering the race detector when `s.initWorkers > 1`, a non-nil error returned by `s.build` in one worker can be overwritten with `nil` by another worker before `return err` executes on line 191, silently swallowing index build failures during startup. Use a local `_, _, err := s.build(...)` inside the closure and an `atomic.Int64` (or `len(stats)`) for `totalBatchesIndexed`.

findings.title: Unsynchronized map iteration in `bleveBackend.TotalDocs` races with `BuildIndex`
findings.body: `TotalDocs()` iterates over `b.cache` without acquiring `b.cacheMu.RLock()`. In `searchSupport.init` (line 216 of `pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go`), `s.search.TotalDocs()` is called immediately after starting the background `WatchWriteEvents` goroutine (line 207), which can invoke `handleEvent` -> `getOrCreateIndex` -> `BuildIndex` and write to `b.cache[key]` under `b.cacheMu.Lock()`. Any concurrent call to `TotalDocs()` while an index is being added to `b.cache` will crash the process with a concurrent map iteration and map write panic.

findings.title: Concurrent `BuildIndex` calls for the same key can fail on disk or overwrite cached indexes
findings.body: Removing the lock around `BuildIndex` without per-key synchronization in `getOrCreateIndex` or `BuildIndex` means two concurrent callers for the same unindexed `NamespacedResource` (for example, concurrent `Search` requests or a `Search` racing with `handleEvent` for a resource with count <= `initMinSize`) will both see `GetIndex == nil` and run `BuildIndex` in parallel. When `size > b.opts.FileThreshold`, the second concurrent `bleve.New(dir, mapper)` call on the same directory path will fail; when using an in-memory index, the second build to finish unconditionally overwrites `b.cache[key] = idx`, discarding any updates written to the first cached index (such as from `handleEvent`) and double-counting the `IndexTenants` and `IndexedKinds` metrics.

findings.title: Postgres test failure in Drone is caused by hardcoded `localhost` in `addStorageServerToConfig`
findings.body: Previously, `TestIntegrationWillRunInstrumentationServerWhenTargetHasNoHttpServer` passed on Postgres in Drone only because `ResourceServer.Init` was called lazily on the first gRPC request, so the test never connected to the `resource_api` database. Now that `NewResourceServer` calls `s.Init(ctx)` at startup, `InitializeModuleServer` connects to the database immediately, which fails in Drone because `addStorageServerToConfig` (lines 75-80) hardcodes `db_host` to `localhost` for Postgres whereas Drone runs Postgres in a separate container. Reading the Postgres host and credentials from the `[database]` section of `cfg` (populated by `db.InitTestDBWithCfg(t)`, just as the MySQL branch does on lines 82-90) will allow this test to run on Postgres instead of skipping it.

findings.title: `ListIterator`, `WriteEvent`, and `ReadResource` still discard the span context
findings.body: While `GetResourceStats` (line 126) and `searchSupport.build` were updated to capture `ctx, span := ...` for trace propagation, `ListIterator` (line 388, which is called by `searchSupport.build` to populate each index), `WriteEvent` (line 158), and `ReadResource` (line 353) still use `_, span := b.tracer.Start(ctx, ...)`. As a result, downstream operations inside those methods (such as `fetchLatestRV`, database queries, `cb(iter)` document building, and `create`/`update`/`delete` spans) will not be parented under their respective `sql.resource.*` spans.
